notes.title: Fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixes a bug that caused clicks to stop working properly.
[*] Fixes the issue with the switches — they should now save as expected again, even after leaving the game. You'll be asked for your character once upon loading. This question won't appear again.

The reason turned out to be that I had integrated the checkpoints into the options menu, which somehow broke the structure.
For now, checkpoints will remain permanently enabled.
I'll create a dedicated options menu for them on the desktop screen at a later time.

notes.title: Undershadows [Update 12]
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Text prompts awaiting player input [100%] have all been edited.
[*] Mouse cursor now changes color [100%] – all updated:
[olist]
[*] Red: NPCs, information, or interactable characters
[*] Green: Clickable objects
[*] Yellow: Visual clues
[/olist]
[*] Many texts have been rearranged or adjusted.
[*] Numerous images have been edited.
[*] Game speed has been adjusted in most sections for a faster pacing.
[*] Several tutorials have been revised.
[*] Some enemies have been reworked (Health adjustments).
[/list]
Issue with old save files:

For some reason, an error could occur where global switches were not being properly loaded in older save files.
Starting a new game works without any issues.
However, when using an old save file, some players encountered problems where their game wouldn't load, or it would load into a blank screen.
The reason for this was that three specific switches were crucial:
[olist]
[*] Character selection
[*] Language selection
[*] An existing game being detected
[/olist]
I’ve now permanently added point 1 and 2 into the options menu, accessible with the "P" key.
Point 3 should be resolved with a fix I’ve implemented.

You can open the options menu from the desktop screen with "P", then re-select your character and language before loading your save file. That should allow even affected saves to work again.

However, this is really just a workaround and admittedly a bit clunky.
If you're affected, it's recommended to simply start a new game.

At this point, aside from the board game system, I believe I’ve implemented all improvement suggestions that have been mentioned so far.

So I’d love to hear your feedback on what I should work on next.

Have a great day/evening!
ChelseaGrinEden

notes.title: Undershadows [Update 11] Undershadows [Update 11] Important!
notes.content:
It is possible that existing save files might encounter a bug.
Some of the global switches could be reset.

This affects the following settings:
[olist]
[*] The desktop screen start
[*] The character selection (Boy or Girl)
[*] The language selection
[/olist]
If you're also affected by this error,
you may need to delete the "config.rmmzsave" file after an update.

It's located in this folder:
SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Undershadows\save

Since this file won't be replaced locally during an update,
everything should work again when you restart the game.

All you have to do is press "P" for the options on the desktop screen after the three tutorial messages are over and select your character and language again.

notes.title: Undershadows [Update 5]
notes.content:
Hello,

here’s a another update for Undershadows.

[list]
[*] A bug with the second campfire has been fixed, so you are now sent to sleep immediately without saving.
[*] A bug with the second campfire when talking to the Mask has been fixed, where an empty field was displayed that served no purpose.
[*] For the first boss, the Mushroom King, a feature has been added where a checkpoint will be unlocked if you die more than five times in the second or third phase.
[*] The enemies in the first two maps of the Grasslands have been made slightly weaker and now have less health, as it was found that with a level 1 Shadow, you couldn't achieve much.
[*] Some hidden items, like Shadow Cookies and Shadow Coffee, have been placed along the way to the Cave of Souls. Finding these will make the early game up to level 2 a little easier.
[*] The school and soul sequences, as well as the conversation with the Mask, have been significantly shortened.
[*] A bug with the glass has been fixed, when the Shadow was pulled out of the ground.
[*] In the machine puzzle, visual numbers have been added to the switches for better understanding, indicating which number they are assigned to.
[/list]
Have a great day/evening!

ChelseaGrinEden

notes.title: Undershadows [Update 3]
notes.content:
Hello,

Here’s a small update for Undershadows that fixes a few things.
[list]
[*] Some players misunderstood the intentionally ‚trash‘ start. It is meant to show how the shadows take over your PC and improvise. To clarify any confusion, I’ve added a conversation where the shadows address the state of things.
[*] The machine puzzle has been expanded with a new button. This moves the rows completely down, so it no longer takes forever to reach the desired point.
[*] Additionally, small visual hints have been added to the machine puzzle.
[/list]

What I’m working on this week:
[list]
[*] Rebuilding the entire text so that it waits for the player’s input, except for certain scenes tied to the music.
[*] Revising the grammar of the text, except for the beginning of the game, because the shadows also messed up the grammar in their "program". 
[*] Redesigning the intro so that it’s not so long, or adding an optional feature.
[/list]
Have a nice day/evening.

ChelseaGrinEden

notes.title: Undershadows [Update 2]
notes.content:
Hello,

Here’s a new update for Undershadows, fixing a few bugs and adding more features.

[list]
[*] A one-time tutorial for loading in the gallery now appears when entering the desktop screen via the [Esc] menu, or when restarting the game if a save file already exists.
[*] The tutorial in the school has been revised to make the Mouse Eye and save function more visible.
[*] An icon now appears in the top-right corner when the game is saved.
[*] Some enemies in the first area have been adjusted to deal less damage.
[/list]

Next, I will be working on redesigning the text for the entire game. The text will now wait for the player's input and won’t disappear on its own. However, some scenes that are tied to music will continue to behave as before.

Have a nice day/evening.

ChelseaGrinEden

notes.title: Undershadows Now on Steam! The Shadows Have Awakened
notes.content:
🎉 Undershadows is now available on Steam! 🎉

The time has finally come – Undershadows is now available on Steam! Dive into the dark and mysterious world of shadows.

I am thrilled to share this project with you, something I’ve been working on for a long time. Your feedback means a lot to me, and I hope you have as much fun playing as I did developing it! It might not be the perfect game, but it was created with a lot of love. :)

Thank you for your support, and have fun playing! 💀

notes.content:
The time has finally come!
